Bench results for the 2026 workstation refresh

System: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
Kernel: 6.5.0-45-generic
CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (8 cores / 16 threads)
Memory: 32 GB DDR4-3200
Storage: 2 TB NVMe (Samsung 990 Pro)
GPU: integrated

Every number below was measured on that machine with the fan curve left at stock.
Each run was repeated five times and the median is what the table reports.
